remarks: Welcome to 15 Deacon Hill Road, a charming Cape-style home located on a quiet cul-de-sac in the Mid-Ridges. This delightful residence boasts 3 spacious bedrooms and 1 stylishly updated full bathroom plus a powder room spread across 1,876 square feet of comfortable living space. Featuring a stunning, updated kitchen designed by the renowned Arianna Thill of ACT Design, with modern finishes, top-of-the-line appliances, and new central air installed in 2024. The expansive .26 acre lot provides ample outdoor space for relaxation and entertainment. With its warm and inviting atmosphere, this home is the perfect blend of classic charm and contemporary amenities.  Centrally located between the Merritt Parkway and I-95. Close to Frank Pepe's New Haven Pizza, Shake Shack, DIG, and other sought-after Bull's Head family-friendly dining options, (along with the much anticipated Stamford Whole Foods).
